From ec3904a25562a105868163a69270ed79718ddb41 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: fertrist <fertrist@rambler.ru>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2016 13:34:44 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] fix "MIME" error introduced by commit
 a39de719e930f450c488dabd21f66f7221e5f80d


diff --git a/src/main/java/org/mishpaha/project/config/SecurityConfig.java b/src/main/java/org/mishpaha/project/config/SecurityConfig.java
index a581a92..62e20fc 100644
--- a/src/main/java/org/mishpaha/project/config/SecurityConfig.java
+++ b/src/main/java/org/mishpaha/project/config/SecurityConfig.java
@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ import org.springframework.security.web.csrf.HttpSessionCsrfTokenRepository;
 
 import javax.sql.DataSource;
 
-@EnableWebSecurity
+@Configuration
 @Order(SecurityProperties.ACCESS_OVERRIDE_ORDER)
 public class SecurityConfig extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter {
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `SecurityConfig.java`**
   - The annotation `@EnableWebSecurity` was replaced with `@Configuration`. This change alters the configuration setup for the security settings in the application.

### Relationships

- The modification in `SecurityConfig.java` indicates a shift from enabling web security through the `@EnableWebSecurity` annotation to defining the class as a configuration class with `@Configuration`. This change is likely intended to resolve a "MIME" error that was introduced in a previous commit, suggesting that the original annotation may have caused issues with the security configuration or its integration with other components in the application.
